messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
Hawaii’s climate is famously mild and pleasant all year, so “the best” month really depends on what you’re after. Here’s a quick guide:

| Goal | Best Months | Why |
|------|-------------|-----|
| **Low‑crowd, good weather, great deals** | **April, May, September, October** | These shoulder seasons have warm, sunny days (70–80 °F / 21–27 °C) but fewer tourists and lower prices. |
| **Surfing (big‑wave season)** | **November–March** | The winter swells are strongest, especially on the North Shore of Oʻahu. |
| **Family beach vacation** | **June–August** | Warmest water (80 °F / 27 °C), plenty of family‑friendly activities, and the school‑year break means more kids on the beach. |
| **Hiking & outdoor adventures** | **April–June, September–October** | Mild temperatures (60–75 °F / 15–24 °C) and lower humidity make trails more comfortable. |
| **Festivals & cultural events** | **Varies** – e.g., **Hawaiʻi County Fair (June)**, **Aloha Festivals (December)**, **Maui Film Festival (April)** | Check specific event calendars. |

### Quick Takeaway
- **If you want the best balance of weather, fewer crowds, and reasonable prices, aim for April, May, September, or October.**  
- **If you’re a surfer, head in winter.**  
- **If you’re a family looking for the warmest beach conditions, summer is ideal.**

Happy planning!
